message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the statutory holidays that create **long weekends** in Canada for the year 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, or the holiday is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Long‑weekend note |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | Mon | All provinces & territories | Sat 1 / Sun 2 / Mon 2 |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Mon | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Ontario, and some others | Mon 20 |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day | Fri | Ontario | Fri 17 / Sat 18 / Sun 19 |
| **Mar 17** | St. George’s Day | Fri | British Columbia | Fri 17 / Sat 18 / Sun 19 |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Fri | All provinces & territories | Fri 7 / Sat 8 / Sun 9 |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Mon | All provinces & territories | Mon 22 |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Mon | All provinces & territories | Sat 1 / Sun 2 / Mon 3 |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Mon | All provinces & territories | Mon 4 |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Mon | All provinces & territories | Mon 9 |
| **Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Mon | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Ontario, and some others | Mon 13 |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Mon | All provinces & territories | Mon 25 |

### Quick notes

* **Observed holidays** – When a statutory holiday falls on a weekend, the holiday is “observed” on the following Monday. Those observed days also create long weekends (e.g., New Year’s Day observed on Jan 2, Canada Day observed on Jul 3, Remembrance Day observed on Nov 13).
* **Provincial variations** – Some holidays (Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, St. George’s Day, Remembrance Day) are only statutory in certain provinces/territories. The table lists the provinces where each holiday is observed.
* **Other holidays** – Holidays that fall on a Wednesday or Thursday (e.g., Boxing Day on Dec 26, 2023) do not automatically create a long weekend unless you take an extra day off.

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or convert it into a JSON array if you prefer a machine‑readable format. Happy planning!
